message.content: The agent fixed the recovered model to use 1 decoder layer, wrote and debugged `/app/tune.py` (fixing weight-transpose and bias-shape errors), tuned only `output_layer` via least squares to improve both call conventions (MSE 1.551→0.162 and 1.543→0.809), saved `/app/model.pt` as TorchScript, and verified all success criteria including unchanged `/app/weights.pt`.
